participation.context: Read the second title twice, and did not go across.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took your own bill first and the Rose's second, and you went back to the Rose's. Then you went on.

title: Read The New World's Tragedy twice

participation.context: Played the afternoon, and brought no other name home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You took the cue as it stood on the slip. You did not give the side a second name.
